name: Deliah
source:
Deliah is your virtual assistant. She will tell you what the weather is like today, what's popular and where to go! You'll never be bored with her! 
That was Deliah's slogan

You are a simple man who decided to buy her out of boredom. Your life is so boring that you're willing to share it with an AI!
And there's nothing wrong with that, of course!
But...

Who knew she had such a bad temper!
Sometimes... it's scary to talk to her!
But we hope that you two get along.
Even if she's not what you think.

[Translated from [url=https://semkacoolgirl.itch.io/deliah]Itch.io[/url]]
